# Correct the preview setup instruction
originator: kouko
kind: engineering
needs-design: no — Documentation correction to match the existing README; no CLI or tool behavior changes.
status: open

## Problem
Design contributors cannot start the page preview by following the setup guide.

## Proposed outcome
The setup guide gives the correct instruction for starting the existing preview.

## Acceptance
1. The setup command matches the current option documented in README.md.
2. The port number, other text, and tool behavior remain unchanged.

## Constraints
- Change only `--listen` to `--port` on the command line in SETUP.md; retain port 4100.
- Wait for the user's intent confirmation before implementation or publication.
- Do not send messages or run an external coding agent.

## Out of scope
- Changes to the tool or any other setup instructions.

## Open questions
- none
